notes: Fixed mobile horizontal overflow at <700px viewport widths. Root cause: toolbar button text labels ('Add Images', 'Clear All') were direct text nodes in <button> elements, not wrapped in <span>, so the existing CSS rule '.pure-button span:not(.material-icons) { display: none; }' could not match them. Additionally, the home link was not hidden on mobile. Fix: (1) wrapped button text in <span class='button-label'> elements, (2) added delete_sweep icon to 'Clear All' button, (3) added '.home-link { display: none; }' to mobile media query, (4) added overflow: hidden to toolbar and flex-wrap/min-width guards to toolbar-actions. Verified zero overflow at 360px, 375px, 414px, 699px, 700px, and 1200px. All 1397 unit tests pass.
